panels.line: Small on purpose: six owners, on their actual books. Someone once called me a user. A user takes and gives nothing back. That word stayed with me for years. So I made a decision: I would count every peso, and I would make sure nobody ever again had to wonder what I bring to the table.     Today, financial clarity for business owners is my advocacy. One Filipino at a time. Because when one owner finally sees their numbers, their family, their team, and everyone downstream of them sees it too.                     For that reason, this first group is different. You are the Founding Six, the first owners to go through The Money That Stays Method. I'm not asking you to prove me right. I'm asking to prove it with you, on your actual books. Your results will become the proof for every owner who comes after you.  So today it is not going to be Php 302,499. It's not even Php 148,000 paid all at once. You start with Php 48,000, and you pay each next phase only when it begins.  And I'll be honest with you: the next cohort will pay more. Not as a trick. Because by then, the proof will already exist, and you're the ones who built it.".
